title: Does VGGT Know What It Does Not Know?
abstract: arXiv:2610.35806v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT regress cameras and geometry in a single forward pass, but they report no uncertainty for the camera poses they predict: an incorrect relative pose looks no different from a correct one. We ask whether the frozen model nonetheless knows when its pose is wrong. On HardMatch, a benchmark of 1,000 deliberately difficult image pairs on which VGGT fails on 35% of pairs, a linear probe on VGGT's frozen features predicts pose failure on held-out categories with ROC-AUC 93.5%, compared with 79.7% for VGGT's own point-map confidence and 77.7% for a classifier trained on all of VGGT's outputs. The probe catches failures VGGT is confident about, lets a downstream system abstain on the pairs it distrusts, and transfers without retraining to rotation failures on PhotoTourism and ScanNet-1500, beyond what co-visibility explains. translated_title: VGGT 是否知道自己不知道什么？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.35806v1，公告类型：cross。摘要：诸如 VGGT 这类前馈式 3D 重建模型可以在单次前向传播中回归出相机位姿与几何，但它们不会对其预测的相机位姿给出任何不确定性度量：一个错误的相对位姿与正确的位姿看起来毫无差别。我们提出疑问：这个参数冻结的模型是否仍然“知道”它的位姿何时出错了？在 HardMatch——一个由 1,000 对刻意挑选的困难图像对组成的基准（VGGT 在其中 35% 的图像对上失败）——上，对 VGGT 冻结特征训练的线性探针在留出类别上预测位姿失败达到 93.5% 的 ROC-AUC，相比之下，VGGT 自身的点图置信度仅为 79.7%，而在 VGGT 全部输出上训练的分类器为 77.7%。该探针能够发现 VGGT 自身“自信”的失败案例，使下游系统可以在其不信任的图像对上选择弃权，并且无需重新训练即可迁移到 PhotoTourism 和 ScanNet-1500 上的旋转失败检测，其效果超出了共可见性（co-visibility）所能解释的范围。这种知识并不存在于逐图像编码器中：它是通过……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明，无需修改或微调模型，仅用线性探针读取冻结的 VGGT 特征即可高精度（ROC-AUC 93.5%）判断其相机位姿预测何时失败，远超 VGGT 自身的置信度指标，并能免训练迁移到其他数据集的失败检测上。
en_tdlr: A simple linear probe on frozen VGGT features can reliably detect (93.5% ROC-AUC) when VGGT's predicted camera poses are wrong, far outperforming its own confidence scores and transferring to other datasets without retraining.
